verses.original: δὲ Περὶ τῶν εἰδωλοθύτων οἴδαμεν ὅτι πάντες ἔχομεν γνῶσιν ἡ γνῶσις φυσιοῖ δὲ ἡ ἀγάπη οἰκοδομεῖ
verses.transliteration: de Peri tōn eidōlothytōn oidamen hoti pantes echomen gnōsin hē gnōsis physioi de hē agapē oikodomei
verses.literal: Now about [food] sacrificed to idols We know that vvv we all have knowledge - Knowledge puffs up but - love builds up

verses.original: εἴ τις δοκεῖ ἐγνωκέναι τι οὔπω ἔγνω καθὼς δεῖ γνῶναι
verses.transliteration: ei tis dokei egnōkenai ti oupō egnō kathōs dei gnōnai
verses.literal: - The one who thinks he knows something vvv does not yet know as he ought to know

verses.original: δέ εἰ τις ἀγαπᾷ τὸν Θεόν οὗτος ἔγνωσται ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: de ei tis agapa ton Theon houtos egnōstai hyp’ autou
verses.literal: But - the one who loves - God - is known by [God]

verses.original: οὖν Περὶ τῆς βρώσεως τῶν εἰδωλοθύτων οἴδαμεν ὅτι εἴδωλον οὐδὲν ἐν κόσμῳ καὶ ὅτι οὐδεὶς Θεὸς εἰ μὴ εἷς
verses.transliteration: oun Peri tēs brōseōs tōn eidōlothytōn oidamen hoti eidōlon ouden en kosmō kai hoti oudeis Theos ei mē heis
verses.literal: So about - eating - food sacrificed to idols We know that an idol [is] nothing at all in [the] world and that [there is] no God but . . . one

verses.original: γὰρ καὶ εἴπερ εἰσὶν λεγόμενοι θεοὶ εἴτε ἐν οὐρανῷ εἴτε ἐπὶ γῆς ὥσπερ εἰσὶν πολλοὶ θεοὶ καὶ πολλοί κύριοι
verses.transliteration: gar kai eiper eisin legomenoi theoi eite en ouranō eite epi gēs hōsper eisin polloi theoi kai polloi kyrioi
verses.literal: For even if there are so-called gods whether in heaven or on earth (as there are many [ so-called ] gods and - lords

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἡμῖν εἷς Θεὸς ὁ Πατήρ ἐξ οὗ πάντα τὰ καὶ εἰς αὐτόν ἡμεῖς καὶ εἷς Κύριος Ἰησοῦς Χριστός δι’ οὗ πάντα τὰ καὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ ἡμεῖς
verses.transliteration: all’ hēmin heis Theos ho Patēr ex hou panta ta kai eis auton hēmeis kai heis Kyrios Iēsous Christos di’ hou panta ta kai di’ autou hēmeis
verses.literal: yet for us [ there is but ] one God the Father from whom all things [came] and for [whom] we [exist] And [ there is but ] one Lord Jesus Christ through whom all things [came] and through [whom] we [exist]

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ οὐκ πᾶσιν ἐν ἡ γνῶσις δὲ τινὲς τῇ συνηθείᾳ ἕως ἄρτι τοῦ εἰδώλου ἐσθίουσιν ὡς εἰδωλόθυτον καὶ αὐτῶν ἡ συνείδησις οὖσα ἀσθενὴς μολύνεται
verses.transliteration: All’ ouk pasin en hē gnōsis de tines tē synētheia heōs arti tou eidōlou esthiousin hōs eidōlothyton kai autōn hē syneidēsis ousa asthenēs molynetai
verses.literal: But not everyone [has] this knowledge - Some [people] are still so accustomed . . . . . . - to idols [that] they eat [such food] as if it were sacrificed to an idol And [since] their - conscience is weak it is defiled

verses.original: δὲ βρῶμα οὐ παραστήσει ἡμᾶς τῷ Θεῷ οὔτε ὑστερούμεθα ἐὰν μὴ φάγωμεν οὔτε μὴ περισσεύομεν ἐὰν φάγωμεν
verses.transliteration: de brōma ou parastēsei hēmas tō Theō oute hysteroumetha ean mē phagōmen oute mē perisseuomen ean phagōmen
verses.literal: But food vvv does not bring us closer . . . to God - We are no worse if vvv we do not eat [and] no [better] if we do

verses.original: Βλέπετε δὲ αὕτη ὑμῶν ἡ ἐξουσία μή πως γένηται πρόσκομμα τοῖς ἀσθενέσιν
verses.transliteration: Blepete de hautē hymōn hē exousia mē pōs genētai proskomma tois asthenesin
verses.literal: Be careful however [that] your - freedom vvv vvv does not become a stumbling block to the weak

verses.original: γάρ ἐὰν τις αὐτοῦ ἀσθενοῦς συνείδησις ἴδῃ σὲ τὸν ἔχοντα γνῶσιν κατακείμενον ἐν εἰδωλείῳ οὐχὶ ἡ ὄντος οἰκοδομηθήσεται εἰς ἐσθίειν τὸ τὰ εἰδωλόθυτα
verses.transliteration: gar ean tis autou asthenous syneidēsis idē se ton echonta gnōsin katakeimenon en eidōleiō ouchi hē ontos oikodomēthēsetai eis esthiein to ta eidōlothyta
verses.literal: For if someone [with] a weak conscience sees you who vvv are well informed eating in an idol’s temple {will he} not - be encouraged to eat - [food] sacrificed to idols

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ ἀσθενῶν ὁ ἀδελφὸς δι’ ὃν Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν ἀπόλλυται ἐν τῇ σῇ γνώσει
verses.transliteration: gar ho asthenōn ho adelphos di’ hon Christos apethanen apollytai en tē sē gnōsei
verses.literal: [So] [this] weak - brother for whom Christ died is destroyed by - your knowledge

verses.original: δὲ ἁμαρτάνοντες εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς οὕτως καὶ τύπτοντες αὐτῶν ἀσθενοῦσαν τὴν συνείδησιν ἁμαρτάνετε εἰς Χριστὸν
verses.transliteration: de hamartanontes eis tous adelphous houtōs kai typtontes autōn asthenousan tēn syneidēsin hamartanete eis Christon
verses.literal: - By sinning against [your] brothers in this way and wounding their weak - conscience you sin against Christ

verses.original: Διόπερ εἰ βρῶμα σκανδαλίζει τὸν μου ἀδελφόν οὐ μὴ φάγω κρέα εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἵνα μὴ σκανδαλίσω τὸν μου ἀδελφόν
verses.transliteration: Dioper ei brōma skandalizei ton mou adelphon ou mē phagō krea eis ton aiōna hina mē skandalisō ton mou adelphon
verses.literal: Therefore if [what I eat] causes - my brother {to stumble} vvv vvv I will never eat meat vvv vvv [again] so that vvv I will not cause - vvv [him] {to stumble}
